title: Equxi Agent Bonds
summary: Make an AI agent operator post a SOL bond, then slash it into a vault and compensate a victim when the agent misbehaves.
what: Equxi is an Anchor 0.31.2 trust layer. Operators register agents and lock SOL bonds; an admin can raise or lower trust scores, slash bonds into a shared vault and pay victims from slash records.
app_note: The page at /dapps/equxi/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/equxi. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/equxi/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call register_agent with your own name, then create_bond with at least 0.1 SOL.
try_steps.see: Your agent PDA (trust score 50) and bond PDA.
try_steps.ran: initialize, register_agent, create_bond, add_constraint, update_trust_score, execute_slash, compensate_victim (see steps).

diagram: operator --register_agent--> agent PDA; operator --create_bond--> bond PDA (SOL); admin --execute_slash--> bond -> vault + slash record; admin --compensate_victim--> vault -> victim
accounts: slash record PDA ["slash", agent, nonce u64]
innovation: Agents carry real economic skin in the game: misbehaviour can be punished from a locked bond and the victim made whole from the same funds.
exercises: Why does initialize check the program data upgrade authority?
What would it take to make execute_slash evidence-based instead of admin-decided?
